# `m.reference.tickers`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Every ticker Massive supports, across asset classes, with its listing details.

```python
m.reference.tickers(symbols=None, *, market=None, ticker_type=None, exchange=None, cusip=None, cik=None, as_of=None, active=True, search=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| `poll()` | holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `Symbol` (`dm.PollMode.REPLACE`) |
| `sort` | `ticker`, `name`, `market`, `locale`, `primary_exchange`, `type`, `currency_symbol`, `currency_name`, `base_currency_symbol`, `base_currency_name`, `cik`, `composite_figi`, `share_class_figi`, `last_updated_utc`, `delisted_utc` |
| `filters` | `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte` |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `Active` | boolean | Whether or not the asset is actively traded. False means the asset has been delisted. | REST |
| `BaseCurrencyName` | String | The name of the currency that this asset is priced against. | REST |
| `BaseCurrencySymbol` | String | The ISO 4217 code of the currency that this asset is priced against. | REST |
| `Cik` | String | The CIK number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Index_Key). | REST |
| `CompositeFigi` | String | The composite OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi) | REST |
| `CurrencyName` | String | The name of the currency that this asset is traded with. | REST |
| `CurrencySymbol` | String | The ISO 4217 code of the currency that this asset is traded with. | REST |
| `DelistedUtc` | Instant | The last date that the asset was traded. | REST |
| `LastUpdatedUtc` | Instant | The information is accurate up to this time. | REST |
| `Locale` | String | The locale of the asset. | REST |
| `Market` | String | The market type of the asset. | REST |
| `Name` | String | The name of the asset. For stocks/equities this will be the companies registered name. For crypto/fx this will be the name of the currency or coin pair. | REST |
| `PrimaryExchange` | String | The ISO code of the primary listing exchange for this asset. | REST |
| `ShareClassFigi` | String | The share Class OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi) | REST |
| `Type` | String | The type of the asset. Find the types that we support via our Ticker Types API (https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/ticker-types). | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |

`RawSymbol` holds Massive's spelling of a symbol the library cannot read; that row's `Symbol` is null, and `RawSymbol` is null on every other row. A session with `unreadable_symbols=dm.OnError.RAISE` (or `DEEPHAVEN_MASSIVE_UNREADABLE_SYMBOLS=raise`) fails on such a row instead and has no `RawSymbol`; the table shows the default session.
